verdict.rationale: Mollie documents HMAC-signed webhook deliveries via the X-Mollie-Signature header with a shared secret. Its next-gen Webhooks API adds event-type subscriptions plus a Webhook Events API for retroactively inspecting past events, which covers signing and event logs. The evidence does not show automatic delivery retries or a way to replay or redeliver events, so only about half the story is covered. Missing for 10: documented automatic retry schedule, event replay/redelivery capability, independent or hands-on corroboration.
